description: This file defines a TVFadeOut class for animating the fade-out effect of a UI element in the Yahoo! widget library. It provides a constructor and methods to animate the element's opacity to hide it smoothly.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.TVFadeOut
classes.description: Class that handles fading out a DOM element with animation.

methods.name: animate()
methods.description: Performs the fade-out animation on the element by gradually reducing its opacity over 0.4 seconds.

methods.name: onComplete()
methods.description: Hides the element after the animation completes by setting display to none and resetting opacity filter.
